description: End-to-end test of the BAS-screenshot-as-reference flow. Use browser-automation-studio to capture a real Swarm Manager page, pass the screenshot as a reference image to gpt-image-2 with input_fidelity='high', and measure how tightly the generated mockup respects the existing layout when the prompt requests a targeted change (e.g., 'same layout, replace the left sidebar with a two-column summary'). Identify drift failure modes and produce a concrete recipe: which BAS command to run, how to pass the image as a reference, what prompt framing prevents unrelated changes. Deliverable: conclusion.md with the recipe and honest assessment of whether grounded mockups are reliable enough to ship.
name: bas-grounded-mockup-flow
title: Validate BAS-grounded UI mockup pipeline
